description:
Every Lamborghini V12… In ONE video!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-03-10

This is the ultimate Lamborghini showdown! 

We’ve got our hands on every Lamborghini powered by a V12, and they’re all going head-to-head in a drag race to see how Lamborghini has evolved over the years! 

So let’s see how they all compare…

Lamborghini Miura P400 SV: 3.9-litre NA V12, 385hp & 400Nm, 5-speed manual, RWD, 1,293kg

Lamborghini Countach 5000S: 4.8-litre NA V12, 375hp & 410Nm, 5-speed manual, RWD, 1,480kg

Lamborghini Diablo: 5.7-litre NA V12, 492hp & 580Nm, 5-speed manual, RWD & 1,576kg

Lamborghini Murcielago LP640: 6.5-litre NA V12, 640hp & 660Nm, AWD & 1,765kg

Lamborghini Aventador SV: 6.5-litre NA V12, 740hp & 690Nm, 7-speed auto, AWD & 1,675kg

Lamborghini Revuelto: 6.5-litre NA V12 & 3 motors, 1,015hp & 1,062Nm, 8-speed auto, AWD & 1,890kg

So will the all-new Revuelto walk it? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!
